title.zh: 卷二十五 志第五: 禮儀五
title.raw: 卷二十五 志第五: 禮儀五 Volume 25 Treatises 5: Rites 5

meta.sourceNote: Body aligned to the chapter heading (juan 25); text and translations taken from 025.json.

sentences.zh: 天授二年，則天既革命稱帝，於東都改制太廟為七廟室，奉武氏七代神主，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshou, after Zetian had changed the mandate and claimed the imperial title, she restructured the Grand Temple in the eastern capital into seven temple chambers, received the spirit tablets of seven generations of the Wu clan, and enshrined them in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshou 2: after Zetian's revolution and enthronement, the eastern-capital Grand Temple became seven chambers, where seven generations of Wu tablets were enshrined.

sentences.zh: 改西京太廟為享德廟，四時唯享高祖已下三室，餘四室令所司閉其門，廢其享祀之禮。

translations.literal: The western capital Great Temple was changed to the Virtue-Enjoying Temple; in the four seasons only the three chambers from Gaozu downward were offered; the remaining four chambers had their doors closed by order and their offering rites abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Western capital's Great Temple became Virtue-Enjoying Temple—only three chambers from Gaozu down were offered; four chambers were closed and their rites ended.

sentences.zh: 又改西京崇先廟為崇尊廟，其享祀如太廟之儀。

translations.literal: Also the western capital Chongxian Temple was changed to Chongzun Temple; its offerings followed the Great Temple rite.
translations.idiomatic: Western Chongxian became Chongzun Temple, with rites like the Great Temple.

sentences.zh: 萬歲登封元年臘月，封嵩山回，親謁太廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Wansui Dengfeng, returning from conferring feng on Mount Song, she personally visited the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Wansui Dengfeng 1, twelfth month: returning from the feng rite on Mount Song, she personally visited the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 明年七月，又改京崇尊廟，為太廟，仍改太廟署為清廟臺，加官員，崇其班秩。

translations.literal: Seventh month next year: also changed the capital Chongzun Temple back to Great Temple; still changed the Great Temple Bureau to Qingmiao Terrace, added staff, and elevated their rank.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, seventh month: Chongzun was restored as Great Temple; the temple office became Qingmiao Terrace with added staff and higher rank.

sentences.zh: 聖曆二年四月，又親祀太廟，曲赦東都城內。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Shengli, she again personally sacrificed at the Grand Temple and granted a special amnesty within the eastern capital walls.
translations.idiomatic: Shengli 2, fourth month: she sacrificed at the Grand Temple again and granted amnesty within the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 中宗即位，神龍元年正月，改享德廟依舊為京太廟。

translations.literal: After Zhongzong took the throne, in the first month of the first year of Shenlong, Xiangde Temple was changed back into the capital Grand Temple as before.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhongzong's accession, Shenlong 1, first month restored Xiangde Temple as the capital Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 五月，遷武氏七廟神主於西京之崇尊廟，東都創置太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month: moved the seven Wu clan temple spirit tablets to western capital Chongzun Temple; newly established Great Temple at eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: seven Wu tablets went to western Chongzun; a new Great Temple rose at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 太常博士張齊賢建議曰：昔孫卿子云：「有天下者事七代，有一國者事五代。」

translations.literal: Grand Ritual Erudite Zhang Qixian cited Xunzi: "The ruler of All Under Heaven serves seven generations; the ruler of one state serves five."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ritual Erudite Zhang Qixian cited Xunzi: "The ruler of All Under Heaven serves seven generations; the ruler of one state serves five."

sentences.zh: 則天子七廟，古今達禮。

translations.literal: Thus the emperor has seven temples, a ritual standard accepted across antiquity and the present.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the emperor has seven temples, a ritual standard accepted across antiquity and the present.

sentences.zh: 故《尚書》稱「七代之廟，可以觀德」。

translations.literal: 《Documents》 says, "Through seven generations of temples, one may observe virtue."
translations.idiomatic: 《Documents》 says, "Through seven generations of temples, one may observe virtue."

sentences.zh: 《祭法》稱「王立七廟，一壇一墠」。

translations.literal: 《Sacrificial Regulations》 says, "The king establishes seven temples, one altar, and one open ground."
translations.idiomatic: 《Sacrificial Regulations》 says, "The king establishes seven temples, one altar, and one open ground."

sentences.zh: 《王制》云：「天子七廟，三昭三穆，與太祖之廟而七。」

translations.literal: The 《Wang System》 says, "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."
translations.idiomatic: The 《Wang System》 says, "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."

sentences.zh: 莫不尊始封之君，謂之太祖。

translations.literal: All such systems honor the first enfeoffed lord as Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: All such systems honor the first enfeoffed lord as Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 太祖之廟，百代不遷。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor's temple remains unmoved for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor's temple remains unmoved for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 袷祭之禮，毀廟之主陳於太祖，未毀廟之主，皆升合食于太祖之室。

translations.literal: At the xia sacrifice, removed temple tablets are arrayed at the Grand Ancestor, while unremoved tablets are raised to share offerings in the Grand Ancestor's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: At the xia sacrifice, removed temple tablets are arrayed at the Grand Ancestor, while unremoved tablets are raised to share offerings in the Grand Ancestor's chamber.

sentences.zh: 太祖東向，昭南向，穆北向。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor faces east; zhao face south, and mu face north.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor faces east; zhao face south, and mu face north.

sentences.zh: 太祖者，商之玄王、周之后稷是也。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestors are exemplified by Xuan Wang of Shang and Hou Ji of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestors are exemplified by Xuan Wang of Shang and Hou Ji of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 太祖之外，更無始祖。

translations.literal: Beyond the Grand Ancestor there is no additional founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Grand Ancestor there is no additional founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 但商自玄王以後，十有四代，至湯而有天下。

translations.literal: From Shang's Xuan Wang to Tang's possession of the realm lay fourteen generations.
translations.idiomatic: From Shang's Xuan Wang to Tang's possession of the realm lay fourteen generations.

sentences.zh: 周自后稷已後，十有七代，至武王而有天下。

translations.literal: From Zhou's Hou Ji to King Wu's possession of the realm lay seventeen generations.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhou's Hou Ji to King Wu's possession of the realm lay seventeen generations.

sentences.zh: 其間代數既遠，遷廟親廟，皆出太祖之後，故得合食有序，尊卑不差。

translations.literal: Since those lines were remote, both removed temples and kin temples stood after the Grand Ancestor, so joint offerings had proper order and rank was not confused.
translations.idiomatic: Since those lines were remote, both removed temples and kin temples stood after the Grand Ancestor, so joint offerings had proper order and rank was not confused.

sentences.zh: 其後漢高祖受命，無始封祖，即以高皇帝為太祖。

translations.literal: When Han Gaozu received the mandate without a first-enfeoffed ancestor, he himself became Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Gaozu received the mandate without a first-enfeoffed ancestor, he himself became Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 太上皇高帝之父，立廟享祀，不在昭穆合食之列，為尊于太祖故也。

translations.literal: Gaozu's father, the Grand Supreme Emperor, received a temple and sacrifices but was not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings, because he was honored above the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's father, the Grand Supreme Emperor, received a temple and sacrifices but was not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings, because he was honored above the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 魏武創業，文帝受命，亦即以武帝為太祖。

translations.literal: Cao Cao founded Wei's enterprise, so when Emperor Wen received the mandate, Emperor Wu likewise became Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Cao founded Wei's enterprise, so when Emperor Wen received the mandate, Emperor Wu likewise became Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 其高皇、太皇、外處君等並為屬尊，不在昭穆合食之列。

translations.literal: Gao Huang, Tai Huang, Waichu Jun, and the others were honored as kin and not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huang, Tai Huang, Waichu Jun, and the others were honored as kin and not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings.

sentences.zh: 晉宣創業，武帝受命，亦即以宣帝為太祖。

translations.literal: Sima Yi founded Jin's enterprise, so when Emperor Wu received the mandate, Emperor Xuan likewise became Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yi founded Jin's enterprise, so when Emperor Wu received the mandate, Emperor Xuan likewise became Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 其征西、豫章、潁川、京兆府君等並為屬尊，不在昭穆合食之列。

translations.literal: The Zhengxi, Yuzhang, Yingchuan, Jingzhao, and other lords were honored as kin and excluded from the zhao-mu shared offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhengxi, Yuzhang, Yingchuan, Jingzhao, and other lords were honored as kin and excluded from the zhao-mu shared offerings.

sentences.zh: 歷茲已降，至於有隋，宗廟之制，斯禮不改。

translations.literal: From those dynasties through Sui, the ancestral-temple rule remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: From those dynasties through Sui, the ancestral-temple rule remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 故宇文氏以文皇帝為太祖，隋室以武元皇帝為太祖。

translations.literal: Thus Northern Zhou treated Emperor Wen as Grand Ancestor, and Sui treated Emperor Wuyuan as Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Northern Zhou treated Emperor Wen as Grand Ancestor, and Sui treated Emperor Wuyuan as Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 國家誕受在命，累葉重光。

translations.literal: Our dynasty received the mandate, and successive generations have renewed its brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty received the mandate, and successive generations have renewed its brilliance.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝始封唐公，實為太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing, first enfeoffed as Duke of Tang, is truly the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing, first enfeoffed as Duke of Tang, is truly the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 中間代數既近，列在三昭三穆之內，故皇家太廟，唯有六室。

translations.literal: Because the line is still close and Emperor Jing falls within the three zhao and three mu, the Tang Grand Temple has only six chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Because the line is still close and Emperor Jing falls within the three zhao and three mu, the Tang Grand Temple has only six chambers.

sentences.zh: 其弘農府君、宣、光二帝，尊于太祖，親盡則遷，不在昭穆合食之數。

translations.literal: The Hongnong Lord, Emperor Xuan, and Emperor Guang stand in honor above the Grand Ancestor; once kinship is exhausted they are moved and are not part of the zhao-mu shared offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Hongnong Lord, Emperor Xuan, and Emperor Guang stand in honor above the Grand Ancestor; once kinship is exhausted they are moved and are not part of the zhao-mu shared offerings.

sentences.zh: 今皇極再造，孝思匪寧。

translations.literal: Now the imperial order has been restored, and filial concern remains unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial order has been restored, and filial concern remains unsettled.

sentences.zh: 奉二月二十九日敕：「七室已下，依舊號尊崇。」

translations.literal: The edict of the twenty-ninth day of the second month said, "For the seven chambers and below, keep the old titles and honors."
translations.idiomatic: The edict of the twenty-ninth day of the second month said, "For the seven chambers and below, keep the old titles and honors."

sentences.zh: 又奉三月一日敕：「既立七廟，須尊崇始祖，速令詳之」者。

translations.literal: The edict of the first day of the third month added, "Since seven temples are being established, the founding ancestor must be honored. Examine this quickly."
translations.idiomatic: The edict of the first day of the third month added, "Since seven temples are being established, the founding ancestor must be honored. Examine this quickly."

sentences.zh: 伏尋禮經，始祖即是太祖，太祖之外，更無始祖。

translations.literal: Looking through the ritual classics, I find that the founding ancestor is the Grand Ancestor, and outside the Grand Ancestor there is no separate founder.
translations.idiomatic: Looking through the ritual classics, I find that the founding ancestor is the Grand Ancestor, and outside the Grand Ancestor there is no separate founder.

sentences.zh: 周朝太祖之外，以周文王為始祖，不合禮經。

translations.literal: For Zhou to set King Wen as a founding ancestor beyond the Grand Ancestor does not fit the ritual classics.
translations.idiomatic: For Zhou to set King Wen as a founding ancestor beyond the Grand Ancestor does not fit the ritual classics.

sentences.zh: 或有引《白虎通義》云「后稷為始祖、文王為太祖、武王為太宗」，及鄭玄注《詩·雍》序云「太祖謂文王」以為說者。

translations.literal: Some explain this by citing 《Baihu tongyi》, "Hou Ji was founding ancestor, King Wen Grand Ancestor, and King Wu Grand Zong," and Zheng Xuan's note to the 《Shi: Yong》 preface, "Grand Ancestor means King Wen."
translations.idiomatic: Some explain this by citing 《Baihu tongyi》, "Hou Ji was founding ancestor, King Wen Grand Ancestor, and King Wu Grand Zong," and Zheng Xuan's note to the 《Shi: Yong》 preface, "Grand Ancestor means King Wen."

sentences.zh: 其義不然。

translations.literal: That interpretation is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: That interpretation is wrong.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 彼以禮「王者祖有功，宗有德，周人祖文王而宗武王」，故謂文王為太祖耳，非袷祭群主合食之太祖。

translations.literal: They call King Wen Grand Ancestor because ritual says, "Rulers make ancestors of those with merit and zong of those with virtue; Zhou made King Wen ancestor and King Wu zong." But this is not the Grand Ancestor who receives all rulers in shared xia offerings.
translations.idiomatic: They call King Wen Grand Ancestor because ritual says, "Rulers make ancestors of those with merit and zong of those with virtue; Zhou made King Wen ancestor and King Wu zong." But this is not the Grand Ancestor who receives all rulers in shared xia offerings.

sentences.zh: 今之議者，或有欲立涼武昭王為始祖者，殊為不可。

translations.literal: Some now wish to make Liang Wuzhao Wang the founding ancestor, but this is especially wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Some now wish to make Liang Wuzhao Wang the founding ancestor, but this is especially wrong.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 昔在商、周，契、稷始封，湯、武之興，祚由契、稷，故以契、稷為太祖，即皇家之景帝是也。

translations.literal: In Shang and Zhou, Xie and Hou Ji were the first enfeoffed ancestors. Tang and Wu rose from their fortune, so Xie and Hou Ji became Grand Ancestors. For our imperial house, that role belongs to Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In Shang and Zhou, Xie and Hou Ji were the first enfeoffed ancestors. Tang and Wu rose from their fortune, so Xie and Hou Ji became Grand Ancestors. For our imperial house, that role belongs to Emperor Jing.

sentences.zh: 涼武昭王勳業未廣，後主失國，土宇不傳。

translations.literal: Liang Wuzhao Wang's merit was limited, his successor lost the state, and the territory did not continue.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Wuzhao Wang's merit was limited, his successor lost the state, and the territory did not continue.

sentences.zh: 景皇始封，實基明命。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing's first enfeoffment truly founded the Tang mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing's first enfeoffment truly founded the Tang mandate.

sentences.zh: 今乃舍封唐之盛烈，崇西涼之遠構，考之前古，實乖典禮。

translations.literal: To abandon the great enfeoffment in Tang and exalt distant Western Liang violates ancient ritual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: To abandon the great enfeoffment in Tang and exalt distant Western Liang violates ancient ritual precedent.

sentences.zh: 魏氏不以曹參為太祖，晉氏不以殷王仰為太祖，宋氏不以楚元王為太祖，齊、梁不以蕭何為太祖，陳、隋不以胡公、楊震為太祖，則皇家安可以涼武昭王為太祖乎？

translations.literal: Wei did not ancestralize Cao Shen, Jin did not ancestralize the King of Yin, Song did not ancestralize King Yuan of Chu, Qi and Liang did not ancestralize Xiao He, and Chen and Sui did not ancestralize Duke Hu or Yang Zhen. How could Tang make Liang Wuzhao Wang Grand Ancestor?
translations.idiomatic: Wei did not ancestralize Cao Shen, Jin did not ancestralize the King of Yin, Song did not ancestralize King Yuan of Chu, Qi and Liang did not ancestralize Xiao He, and Chen and Sui did not ancestralize Duke Hu or Yang Zhen. How could Tang make Liang Wuzhao Wang Grand Ancestor?

sentences.zh: 漢之東京，大議郊祀，多以周郊后稷，漢當郊堯。

translations.literal: In Eastern Han, a major debate over suburban sacrifice held that because Zhou offered to Hou Ji, Han should offer to Yao.
translations.idiomatic: In Eastern Han, a major debate over suburban sacrifice held that because Zhou offered to Hou Ji, Han should offer to Yao.

sentences.zh: 制上公卿議，議者多同，帝亦然之。

translations.literal: The court sent the issue to the ministers; most agreed, and the emperor was inclined to agree as well.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent the issue to the ministers; most agreed, and the emperor was inclined to agree as well.

sentences.zh: 杜林正議，獨以為「周室之興，祚由后稷。

translations.literal: Only Du Lin argued correctly: "The rise of Zhou came through Hou Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Only Du Lin argued correctly: "The rise of Zhou came through Hou Ji.

sentences.zh: 漢業特起，功不緣堯。

translations.literal: Han arose on its own; its merit did not derive from Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Han arose on its own; its merit did not derive from Yao.

sentences.zh: 祖宗故事，所宜因循。」

translations.literal: The old precedents for ancestors and zong should be followed."
translations.idiomatic: The old precedents for ancestors and zong should be followed."

sentences.zh: 竟從林議。

translations.literal: The court ultimately followed Du Lin.
translations.idiomatic: The court ultimately followed Du Lin.

sentences.zh: 又傳稱，「欲知天上，事問長人」，以其近之。

translations.literal: Another tradition says, "To know Heaven, ask the elders," because they stand closer to it.
translations.idiomatic: Another tradition says, "To know Heaven, ask the elders," because they stand closer to it.

sentences.zh: 武德、貞觀之時，主聖臣賢，其去涼武昭王蓋亦近於今矣。

translations.literal: The Wude and Zhenguan rulers were sagely and their ministers worthy, and they were closer to Liang Wuzhao Wang's time than we are.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude and Zhenguan rulers were sagely and their ministers worthy, and they were closer to Liang Wuzhao Wang's time than we are.

sentences.zh: 當時不立者，必不可立故也。

translations.literal: If they did not establish him then, he surely should not be established now.
translations.idiomatic: If they did not establish him then, he surely should not be established now.

sentences.zh: 今既年代浸遠，方復立之，是非三祖二宗之意。

translations.literal: To establish him only after so many years would violate the intent behind the three ancestors and two zong.
translations.idiomatic: To establish him only after so many years would violate the intent behind the three ancestors and two zong.

sentences.zh: 實恐景皇失職而震怒，武昭虛位而不答，非社稷之福也。

translations.literal: I fear Emperor Jing would be displaced and angered, while Wuzhao would hold an empty position and give no response; this would not benefit the state.
translations.idiomatic: I fear Emperor Jing would be displaced and angered, while Wuzhao would hold an empty position and give no response; this would not benefit the state.

sentences.zh: 宗廟事重，禘祫禮崇，先王以之觀德。

translations.literal: Temple affairs are weighty, and the di and xia rites are exalted; through them the former kings observed virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Temple affairs are weighty, and the di and xia rites are exalted; through them the former kings observed virtue.

sentences.zh: 或者不知其說，既灌而往，孔子不欲觀之。

translations.literal: Some fail to understand this. Confucius himself did not wish to watch after the libation had passed.
translations.idiomatic: Some fail to understand this. Confucius himself did not wish to watch after the libation had passed.

sentences.zh: 今朝命惟新，宜應慎禮，祭如神在，理不可誣。

translations.literal: Now that the dynasty's mandate has been renewed, ritual must be handled carefully. Sacrifice is performed as if the spirits were present; it cannot be falsified.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the dynasty's mandate has been renewed, ritual must be handled carefully. Sacrifice is performed as if the spirits were present; it cannot be falsified.

sentences.zh: 請准敕加太廟為七室，享宣皇帝以備七代，其始祖不合別有尊崇。

translations.literal: I request that the Grand Temple be expanded to seven chambers and Emperor Xuan be sacrificed to as the seventh generation; no separate honor should be given to another founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the Grand Temple be expanded to seven chambers and Emperor Xuan be sacrificed to as the seventh generation; no separate honor should be given to another founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 太常博士劉承慶、尹知章又議云：謹按《王制》：「天子七廟，三昭三穆，與太祖之廟而七。」

translations.literal: Grand Ritual Erudites Liu Chengqing and Yin Zhizhang also cited the 《Wang System》: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ritual Erudites Liu Chengqing and Yin Zhizhang also cited the 《Wang System》: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."

sentences.zh: 此載籍之明文，古今之通制。

translations.literal: This is the clear written rule and the common system of antiquity and later ages.
translations.idiomatic: This is the clear written rule and the common system of antiquity and later ages.

sentences.zh: 皇唐稽考前範，詳采列辟，崇建宗靈，式遵斯典。

translations.literal: Tang examined earlier models, drew carefully on past rulers, built up the ancestral spirits, and followed this canon.
translations.idiomatic: Tang examined earlier models, drew carefully on past rulers, built up the ancestral spirits, and followed this canon.

sentences.zh: 但以開基之主，受命之君，王跡有淺深，太祖有遠近。

translations.literal: Yet founders and mandate-receiving rulers differ: royal traces may be deep or shallow, and Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.
translations.idiomatic: Yet founders and mandate-receiving rulers differ: royal traces may be deep or shallow, and Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.

sentences.zh: 湯、文祚基契、稷，太祖代遠，出乎昭穆之上，故七廟可全。

translations.literal: Tang and King Wen were rooted in Xie and Hou Ji; because those Grand Ancestors were remote and stood above the zhao-mu line, the full seven temples were possible.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and King Wen were rooted in Xie and Hou Ji; because those Grand Ancestors were remote and stood above the zhao-mu line, the full seven temples were possible.

sentences.zh: 若夏繼唐、虞，功非由鯀；

translations.literal: Xia succeeded Tang and Yu, but its merit did not derive from Gun;
translations.idiomatic: Xia succeeded Tang and Yu, but its merit did not derive from Gun;

sentences.zh: 漢除秦、項，力不因堯。

translations.literal: Han destroyed Qin and Xiang, but its power did not come from Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Han destroyed Qin and Xiang, but its power did not come from Yao.

sentences.zh: 及魏、晉經圖，周、隋撥亂，皆勳隆近代，祖業非遠，受命始封之主，不離昭穆之親，故肇立宗祊，罕聞全制。

translations.literal: Wei, Jin, Zhou, and Sui won their achievements in recent generations, not through remote ancestral enterprises; their mandate-receiving founders still lay within the zhao-mu kinship line, so their first temple systems were rarely complete.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, Jin, Zhou, and Sui won their achievements in recent generations, not through remote ancestral enterprises; their mandate-receiving founders still lay within the zhao-mu kinship line, so their first temple systems were rarely complete.

sentences.zh: 夫太祖以功建，昭穆以親崇，有功百代而不遷，親盡七葉而當毀。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor rests on merit; zhao and mu rest on kinship. Merit keeps a tablet unmoved for a hundred generations, while exhausted kinship after seven leaves requires removal.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor rests on merit; zhao and mu rest on kinship. Merit keeps a tablet unmoved for a hundred generations, while exhausted kinship after seven leaves requires removal.

sentences.zh: 或以太祖代淺，廟數非備，更于昭穆之上，遠立合遷之君，曲從七廟之文，深乖迭毀之制。

translations.literal: To force the seven-temple wording by adding a remote but movable ruler above the zhao-mu line, merely because the Grand Ancestor is near, would badly violate the rule of successive removal.
translations.idiomatic: To force the seven-temple wording by adding a remote but movable ruler above the zhao-mu line, merely because the Grand Ancestor is near, would badly violate the rule of successive removal.

sentences.zh: 皇家千齡啟旦，百葉重光。

translations.literal: The imperial house opened a thousand-year dawn and renewed the brightness of a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial house opened a thousand-year dawn and renewed the brightness of a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝浚德基唐，代數猶近，號雖崇于太祖，親尚列于昭穆，且臨六室之位，未申七代之尊。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing founded Tang in deep virtue, but his generation is still near. Though honored as Grand Ancestor, by kinship he remains within the zhao-mu line and one of the six chambers, not yet creating the honor of seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing founded Tang in deep virtue, but his generation is still near. Though honored as Grand Ancestor, by kinship he remains within the zhao-mu line and one of the six chambers, not yet creating the honor of seven generations.

sentences.zh: 是知太廟當六，未合有七。

translations.literal: Thus the Grand Temple should have six chambers and not yet seven.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Grand Temple should have six chambers and not yet seven.

sentences.zh: 故先朝惟有宣、光、景、元、神、堯、文武六代親廟。

translations.literal: The former court therefore had only six generations of kin temples: Xuan, Guang, Jing, Yuan, Shenyao, and Wenwu.
translations.idiomatic: The former court therefore had only six generations of kin temples: Xuan, Guang, Jing, Yuan, Shenyao, and Wenwu.

sentences.zh: 大帝登遐，神主升祔於廟室，以宣皇帝代數當滿，准禮復遷。

translations.literal: When the Great Emperor died and his tablet was enshrined, Emperor Xuan's generations were complete, so ritual moved him out again.
translations.idiomatic: When the Great Emperor died and his tablet was enshrined, Emperor Xuan's generations were complete, so ritual moved him out again.

sentences.zh: 今止有光皇帝已下六代親廟，非是天子之廟數不當有七，要由太祖有遠近之異，故初建有多少之殊。

translations.literal: Now there are only six generations of kin temples from Emperor Guang down. This does not mean the emperor should not have seven temples; it means the number at establishment varies because Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.
translations.idiomatic: Now there are only six generations of kin temples from Emperor Guang down. This does not mean the emperor should not have seven temples; it means the number at establishment varies because Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.

sentences.zh: 敬惟三后臨朝，代多儒雅，神祊事重，禮豈虛存，規模可沿，理難變革。

translations.literal: The three former reigns had many learned classicists, and temple affairs were weighty. Their ritual model was not empty; it can be followed, and principle does not favor changing it.
translations.idiomatic: The three former reigns had many learned classicists, and temple affairs were weighty. Their ritual model was not empty; it can be followed, and principle does not favor changing it.

sentences.zh: 宣皇既非始祖，又廟無祖宗之號，親盡既遷，其在不合重立。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan is not the founder, and his temple has no zu or zong title. Since his kinship line was exhausted and he was moved, he should not be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan is not the founder, and his temple has no zu or zong title. Since his kinship line was exhausted and he was moved, he should not be restored.

sentences.zh: 若禮終運往，建議復崇，實違《王制》之文，不合先朝之旨。

translations.literal: To exalt him again after the ritual order has moved on would violate the 《Wang System》 and the former court's intent.
translations.idiomatic: To exalt him again after the ritual order has moved on would violate the 《Wang System》 and the former court's intent.

sentences.zh: 請依貞觀之故事，無改三聖之宏規，光崇六室，不虧古議。

translations.literal: We request following Zhenguan precedent, preserving the grand rule of the Three Sages, and honoring the six chambers without impairing the ancient judgment.
translations.idiomatic: We request following Zhenguan precedent, preserving the grand rule of the Three Sages, and honoring the six chambers without impairing the ancient judgment.
